purpose: DISCOVERY CANDIDATES ONLY. Not approved training data until verified + license-audited.

candidates.name: HumanEval
candidates.notes: 164 hand-written Python problems with unit tests. Canonical code benchmark => evaluation_only.

candidates.name: HumanEval+
candidates.notes: HumanEval with 80x more generated tests; stricter eval. evaluation_only.

candidates.name: MBPP
candidates.notes: 974 crowd-sourced Python problems with tests. Has train/validation/test; 'train' split can be used with care (benchmark contamination risk on test).

candidates.name: MBPP+
candidates.notes: Hardened MBPP with expanded tests. evaluation_only.

candidates.name: APPS
candidates.notes: 10k competitive-programming problems with test cases and difficulty (intro/interview/competition).

candidates.name: CodeContests
candidates.notes: 13k+ competitive programming problems with correct/incorrect solutions and generated tests.

candidates.name: CodeSearchNet
candidates.notes: 2M (docstring, code) pairs across 6 languages. Natural-language->code mapping.

candidates.name: The Stack
candidates.notes: 3TB permissively-licensed source code (30+ languages). Raw code => low WSTU fit alone; needs conversion into QA/decision pairs. LICENSE of each source repo is the binding constraint.

candidates.name: StarCoderData
candidates.notes: Derived Go/Python-heavy subset of The Stack. Raw code corpus; per-repo license filtering applied upstream.

candidates.name: CodeAlpaca
candidates.notes: 20k instruction/response code pairs generated with text-davinci-002. data_origin=synthetic; verify license.
